description: The first argument of a test function. Jest hands it `done` when it declares a parameter (fn.length > 0, a default or rest parameter does not count): done() passes, done(error) and done(reason) fail with the error or `Failed: <reason>`, a second done() throws and fails, done plus a returned value fails, a done that never comes times out. Vitest hands every test its context, a function that throws "done() callback is deprecated, use promise instead", so each of these fails with that error.
